sets.notesEn: The card's premise has no single answer: in the 55 Bundesliga seasons 1964–2018 Borussia Mönchengladbach (1970, 1971, 1975, 1976, 1977) and Borussia Dortmund (1995, 1996, 2002, 2011, 2012) both won exactly 5 titles, so either club (or both) should be accepted. Bayern München won 27 of the 55.

Bayern München gewann 27 der 55.
